description: This file contains type-checking utility functions for various item interfaces such as DecryptedItem, EncryptedItem, and DeletedItem within the domain model. It provides type guards and predicate functions to determine the specific type or state of items based on their payloads.

methods.name: export function isDecryptedItem(item: ItemInterface): item is DecryptedItemInterface { isDecryptedItem
methods.description: Type guard that checks if an item is a DecryptedItem based on its payload.

methods.name: export function isEncryptedItem(item: ItemInterface): item is EncryptedItemInterface { isEncryptedItem
methods.description: Type guard that checks if an item is an EncryptedItem based on its payload.

methods.name: export function isNotEncryptedItem( isNotEncryptedItem
methods.description: Type guard that checks if an item is neither encrypted nor decrypted, i.e., it is Decrypted or Deleted.

methods.name: export function isDeletedItem(item: ItemInterface): item is DeletedItemInterface { isDeletedItem
methods.description: Type guard that checks if an item is a DeletedItem based on its payload.

methods.name: export function isDecryptedOrDeletedItem(item: ItemInterface): item is DecryptedItemInterface | / isDecryptedOrDeletedItem
methods.description: Composite type guard that checks if an item is either decrypted or deleted.

methods.name: export function isEncryptedErroredItem(item: ItemInterface): boolean { isEncryptedErroredItem
methods.description: Checks if an encrypted item has a decrypting error.
